title: GPCR identification in parasitic worm genome assemblies
protocol: Acquire all previously identified GPCR gene IDs from C. elegans, B. malayi, O. volvulus, S. mansoni, and S. mediterranea.
Use the WormBase ParaSite API to pull out orthologues in the database based on the acquired gene ID seeds.
Organize pulled orthologous gene IDs and their sequences into gene families.
Align the sequences of each family using MAFFT (--auto).
Trim remove columns containing ambiguous sites or poorly aligned characters using trimal (-automated1).
Create profile Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) for each trimmed alignment using HHsuite (hmmbuild).
Acquire curated HMM databases from UniProt, SCOPUS, Pfam, and the PDB.
Search each family HMM against the four acquired databases using HHsuite (hmmsearch).
Retain the best-hit for each search in each database.
Manually peruse the best-hits for each family.
Remove families containing less than 2 GPCR-like best-hits.
Use blastp to search against the NCBI non-redundant protein database with two or three representative sequences from each family.
Cross-reference the annotations of significant hits with GPCRdb to categorize the GPCR family.
Append manually identified GPCR families to the final list of putative GPCR families and their members.
